title: JSFL: document.selection has no setter — doc.selection = [elem] silently no-ops
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, doc.selection is readonly (getter only). Flash 8 JSFL allows doc.selection = [elem] to programmatically set the selection to an array of elements. Fix: add a set selection(value) setter that accepts an array of JsflElement objects (or null/[]) and updates state.selectedIds accordingly. Look at how setSelectionRect() sets selectedIds for reference.
